subject: Include quadratic terms in Deducer's Linear Regression Model Builder

messages.author: 2e26cd3b44f99b61
messages.subject: Include quadratic terms in Deducer's Linear Regression Model Builder
parts:
What should I do in Deducer's Linear Regression Model Builder to produce a formula like the following

lm(ozone~temp*wind*rad+I(rad^2)+I(temp^2)+I(wind^2))

In the Outcomes text box I have the ozone variable and temp, wind and rad are in the Variables text box.

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Include quadratic terms in Deducer's Linear Regression Model Builder
parts:
You can enter them as orthogonal polynomials with the poly button, or
just edit the terms directly to be I(variable^2) by double clicking.

ian
